LR-02.rule: routing completeness / DRC unconnected_items (prerequisite for PE-PCB-005, PE-PCB-007, PE-PCB-008 acceptance)
LR-02.evidence: verification/drc/20261010T104013Z-drc-7a5fd84b/drc.json: 39 unconnected items on 20 nets - XRS_N 6 (U4.1, TP13.1, R24.2, D2.1, U8.13, U5.80, U3.22), FLT_H_N 3, FLT_L_N 3, OTP_N 3, PG_BIAS_S_N 3, RDY_H 3, RDY_L 3, ADC_TEMP_HS 2, OVP_IN_N 2, and 1 each on BIAS_EN, BOOT87, G1_N, OVP_N, OVP_OUT_N, PG_BIAS_H_OK, PG_BIAS_L_OK, PG_BIAS_S_OK, RELAY_ON, SPARE_D2, TDI. routing_progress_control.json lists all 39 as router 'route' failures; endpoints cluster between the DSP PWM/fault pin side (U5 pins 10-26 at y = 45.7 mm, x = 61-70 mm) and the fault combiner U8/U10/U11 at y = 56-65 mm, plus the board-spanning XRS_N (U4 at x = 12.4 to U5 at x = 80.7 and U3 at x = 49.9). Only two routing layers (F.Cu, B.Cu) exist by design; 4151 tracks, 642 vias.
LR-02.proposed_correction: Create routing room on the DSP's PWM/fault side: move the logic region (U8, U9, U10, U11 and their resistors) >= 3 mm further from the DSP's bottom escape rows and spread it along x; allow the router 0.15 mm track / 0.15 mm clearance (the pcb_stackup fabrication minimum) in the escape field; put XRS_N, TDI, FLT_H_N, FLT_L_N, RDY_H, RDY_L, OTP_N, PG_BIAS_S_N, RELAY_ON, BIAS_EN early in SIGNAL_ORDER; give XRS_N a pre-routed B.Cu lane across the top of the DSP toward U4; re-run the generator and kicad-cli DRC until unconnected_items = 0.

LR-07.rule: PE-PCB-006 (IPC-2221 width check) / project CTRL_PWR net class (track_width 1.0 mm)
LR-07.evidence: Router NET_RULES used 0.4 mm for 12V_IN (42 segments, 62 mm), EFUSE_RTN (71 segments, 67 mm), 5V_SW and 0.3 mm for 12V_PROT (21 segments) and 5V (44 segments); the project net class CTRL_PWR specifies 1.0 mm. IPC-2221 external, 35 um: 1.96 A (eFuse I_CB) on 0.4 mm -> 28.8 K rise, 1.76 A (worst pull-in) -> 22.5 K, 1.96 A on 0.3 mm -> 46 K, on 1.0 mm -> 6.4 K. Layer transitions: 2 parallel 0.3 mm vias at U1.1/U1.2 (12V_IN) and at U1.15/U1.16 (12V_PROT) -> ~1 A each, 2.2 K (external formula) / 10.7 K (internal). Bulk 12V_PROT and 5V current flows in the In2.Cu islands (1453.7 / 608.5 mm2), so the hot spots are the short outer-layer stubs; 12V_PROT corridor fingers on In2.Cu are 1.2-1.3 mm wide (1.3 A -> 7.8 K internal).
LR-07.proposed_correction: Set NET_RULES width 1.0 mm (class value) for 12V_IN, 12V_PROT, EFUSE_RTN, 5V, 5V_SW (0.6 mm minimum where the SOT-23-6 / HTSSOP pads limit), add a third via at the eFuse input and output, widen the 12V_PROT corridor fingers to >= 2 mm; re-run and re-check with the IPC-2221 formula in the metrics checker.

LR-08.evidence: verification/engineering_checks/layout_spec_power.json (unmodified since 14:48) versus design/circuit_power.json: barrier_parts list U2 as 'UCC21710 LS driver' (schematic U2 = UCC14141 HS bias), U3 as 'UCC14141 HS gate bias' (schematic U3 = UCC21710 LS driver), U8 as 'TMCS1133' (schematic U8 = OPA2320; TMCS1133 is U10 and is absent from the list); gate_loops Q2 driver_ref 'U2' (should be U3) with driver_output_pads/return_pads placeholders; mosfets drain_pad 2 / source_pad 3 / gate_pad 1 / kelvin_pad 4 (schematic Q1: 1 VIN drain, 2 SW source, 3 KS_H, 4 G_H; Q2: 1 SW, 2 PGND, 3 KS_L, 4 G_L); decoupling supply nets COM_H / COM_L (schematic uses KS_H / KS_L); sensing kelvin_pairs VIN_DIV_P/N, VOUT_DIV_P/N (schematic: single VIN_DIV, VOUT_DIV); CTRL_SELV patterns omit 12V_BIAS_H/L/S, GNDP_H/L/S, PWM_H_F, PWM_L_F, RESET_N_F, BIAS_EN_F, REF2V5_PB, K1_LOW, RLY_G, VIN_AMP_P/N, VOUT_AMP_P/N, VIN_OUTP/N, VOUT_OUTP/N (all CTRL_SELV in the .kicad_pro), so the 9.0 mm HV-to-SELV measurement would skip them; compactness heights 'C2[0-9]' 45 mm (the 45 mm films are C13/C14, the 37 mm films C11/C12) and L1 40 mm (baseline 48 mm). LR-10.rule: PE-PCB-008 / grounding (schematic-level, surfaced by the layout)
LR-10.evidence: Model and board: net EFUSE_RTN connects only U1 pin 8 (RTN), U1 pin 17 (PAD), R3.2, R4.2, R5.2, C2.2 - no part or copper joins it to GND_CTRL (DRC 0 violations confirms the nets are isolated in copper). The U1 note in design/circuit_control.json says 'RTN separate from GND (A-C3); PowerPad on RTN', but no assumption A-C3 exists in design/assumptions.md or design_decisions.json; the research record controller_aux_interconnect.json expected the 'PowerPAD stitched to the RTN/GND plane'. I12V_MON is the IMON current across R5 to EFUSE_RTN and is read by ADCINB0 against GND_CTRL, which is meaningless if EFUSE_RTN floats. The TPS26400 RTN pin is the device return and is to be connected to system ground per the datasheet (to be confirmed by the schematic owner).
LR-10.proposed_correction: Schematic owner to confirm the TPS26400 RTN/GND/PAD connection and either tie EFUSE_RTN to GND_CTRL (single point at the eFuse or merge the nets) or document the undefined assumption A-C3 with its rationale; the layout then follows the corrected netlist. Not a layout change.
